sanskrit: indreṇa datto varuṇena śiṣṭo marudbhir ugraḥ prayato na āgan | etaṃ vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī pari dadāmi sa mā tṛṣat sa mā kṣudhat ||
english: Given by Indra, directed by Varuṇa, fierce and set in motion by the Maruts, he has come to us. This one I deliver into your two hands, O Heaven-and-Earth — may he neither thirst nor hunger.

sanskrit: ūrjam asmā ūrjasvatī dhattaṃ payo 'smai payasvatī dhattam | ūrjam asmai dyāvāpṛthivī adhātāṃ viśve devā maruta ūrjam āpaḥ ||
english: Grant him vital nourishment, O nourishment-rich one; grant him milk, O milk-rich one. Let Heaven-and-Earth bestow vital nourishment upon him; let all the gods, the Maruts, and the Waters bestow vital nourishment.

sanskrit: śivā asya hṛdayaṃ tarpayantv anamīvo modamānaś careha | savāsinau pibatāṃ mantham etam aśvino rūpaṃ paridhāya māyām ||
english: May the auspicious ones satisfy his heart; free from disease, let him move about here rejoicing. May the two Aśvins, assuming a form by their magic power, together clothed, drink this mixed drink.

sanskrit: tasya pātāraṃ sacatāṃ purīṣam ūrjā svadhā sacatām etam eṣā | indra etāṃ sasṛje viddho agra ūrjāṃ svadhām ajarāṃ sā ta eṣā | tayā tvaṃ jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā mā ta ā susrod bhiṣajas te akran ||
english: May the purifying draught attend his drinking; may vital nourishment and self-sustaining power attend him — this is she. Indra, struck first, released her — she is that vital nourishment and ageless self-sustaining power for you. By her may you live through autumns radiant with vigor; may it not flow away from you — the healers have made it fast for you.

sanskrit: viśve devāso abhi rakṣatemam utādityā jāgṛta yūyam asmin | memaṃ samāna uta vānyanābhir memaṃ prāpat pauruṣeyo vadho yaḥ ||
english: O All-Gods, protect this man; and you Ādityas, be wakeful over him. Let not a rival, nor one of different lineage reach him; let not the man-slaying blow reach him.

sanskrit: ye vo devāḥ pitaro ye ca putrāḥ sacetaso me śṛṇutedam uktam | sarvebhyo vaḥ pari dadāmy etaṃ ta enaṃ svasti jarase nayātha ||
english: You who are gods, and those who are fathers and those who are sons — of one mind, hear this utterance of mine. I deliver this man over to all of you; may you lead him in well-being to old age.

sanskrit: ye devā divi ṣṭha ye pṛthivyāṃ ye antarikṣa oṣadhīṣv apsu | te kṛṇuta jarasam āyur asmai śatam anyān pari vṛṇakta mṛtyūn ||
english: You gods who dwell in heaven, who are on earth, who are in the atmosphere, in the plants, in the waters — make long life and old age his lot; ward off a hundred other deaths from him.

sanskrit: yeṣāṃ prayājā uta vānuyājā hutabhāgā ahutādaś ca devāḥ | yeṣāṃ vaḥ pañca pradiśo vibhaktās tān vo asmai sattrasadaḥ kṛṇomi ||
english: Those gods for whom there are fore-offerings and after-offerings, who have shares in the oblation poured and unpoured, for whom the five directions are apportioned among you — those who sit at the sacrificial session, I make them into protectors for this man.

sanskrit: ahaṃ te bhagam ā dade 'dhi śīrṣṇa iva srajam | mahāmūla iva parvato jyok pitṛṣv āsāsai ||
english: I take hold of your good fortune, as a garland upon the head. Like a mountain with a great root, may you long sit among your fathers.

sanskrit: iyaṃ te rājan kanyā vadhūr ni dhūyate yama | sā mātur badhyatāṃ gṛhe 'tho bhrātur atho pituḥ ||
english: O Yama, king, this maiden is shaken loose as a bride for you. Let her be bound in the house of her mother, and also of her brother, and also of her father.

sanskrit: iyaṃ te ketapā rājann imāṃ te pari dadhmasi | jyok pitṛṣv āsātā ā śīrṣṇaḥ samopyāt ||
english: O king, this one is your guardian of emblems; we deliver this one over to you. May she long sit among the fathers; may it reach fully to the crown of her head.

sanskrit: asitasya brahmaṇā kaśyapasya gayasya ca | antaḥkośam iva jāmayo api nahyāmi te bhagam ||
english: By the sacred power of Asita, of Kaśyapa, and of Gaya — like female kin binding an inner treasure-sack, I bind up your good fortune.
